title: Perform Visual and Functional Regression Testing
description: Test the dashboard to ensure the smaller button looks correct, is responsive, and remains fully functional.
details: Manually test the dashboard page in local development. Confirm the button's appearance, alignment, and clickability. If automated visual regression tools or Storybook are in use, update or review relevant stories. Run through the key creation flow to ensure no functionality is broken.
test_strategy: Manual QA: check appearance, responsiveness, and function. If available, run automated visual regression tests and update snapshots as needed. Confirm accessibility (focus, ARIA labels) is preserved.

title: Update Button Size on Dashboard
description: Reduce the size of the '+ Create New Key' button on the dashboard to make it more compact, using the design system's built-in options.
details: Locate the '+ Create New Key' <Button> component instance in 'app/dashboard/page.tsx'. Update its props to use size="sm" (or the smallest available variant) from the shadcn/ui Button component. If further reduction is needed, add Tailwind CSS utility classes (e.g., 'px-3 py-1.5', 'text-sm') to the className prop for finer control. Ensure any internal icon also scales appropriately, adjusting its size if necessary.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the dashboard to confirm the button is smaller and maintains alignment with surrounding elements. Check responsiveness across breakpoints. If Storybook is present, verify the button story. Ensure the button remains functional and triggers the key creation flow as before.

title: Adjust Layout if Needed for Smaller Button
description: Ensure that reducing the button size does not negatively impact the layout or alignment of adjacent elements on the dashboard.
details: After resizing the button, review the parent container and adjacent elements for any layout shifts or misalignments. Adjust spacing, alignment, or flex/grid properties as needed to maintain a polished appearance. Avoid introducing magic numbers; use Tailwind spacing utilities or design system values.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the dashboard on various screen sizes to confirm layout integrity. Use browser dev tools to check for overflow or misalignment. Confirm keyboard navigation and accessibility are unaffected.

title: Verify Icon Scaling Within Button
description: Ensure that any icon inside the '+ Create New Key' button scales down proportionally with the reduced button size.
details: If the button includes an icon (e.g., a plus sign), verify that its size matches the new button dimensions. Adjust the icon's size prop or apply Tailwind classes (e.g., 'w-4 h-4') as needed to maintain visual balance and alignment with the text.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the button to confirm the icon is not oversized or misaligned. Test on different devices and with various accessibility settings (e.g., increased font size).
